# Pinned dstack event-log source

Source: `https://github.com/Dstack-TEE/dstack`, commit `4699c48ea3a7e568dff4f8792421299f27d50758` (v0.6.0). Archive URL `https://codeload.github.com/Dstack-TEE/dstack/tar.gz/4699c48ea3a7e568dff4f8792421299f27d50758`, SHA-256 `2157cdcbf2e1a6ac0d727197e4241913a18ef0c9ceb23bcb7622f9a7b15d4726`.

These three complete crate directories (including tests and sample data) and root Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` are copied from that archive; their Rust source is unmodified; one trailing Markdown space pair in size-parser's README was removed. The nested root `Cargo.toml` is a reduced replacement: only these three workspace members and their actual direct dependencies, no unrelated upstream network/git sources. Product root Cargo dependencies use path dependencies and a committed lockfile. The original root manifest calls the workspace package `MIT` although its SPDX header, all copied source/manifests and root LICENSE say `Apache-2.0`; this replacement labels the copied files Apache-2.0 and preserves their headers and root licence. The source archive also contains `LICENSES/MIT.txt`; do not infer that its root Apache files are MIT-only. Revisit the discrepancy with upstream when upgrading. Do not fetch this tree at build time.
